title: Satisfied
text: “Ah, Master! The choco’s so yummy!”
When I pressed her for an answer, Rafumi gave a snort of laughter, then broke into a smile and spoke.
“Can’t you tell?”
“Don’t beat around the bush, I say!”
“I doubt he’d get it… what exactly are you doing?”
“Ha, to think you can’t appreciate my hard work. Shield Hero, you’ve spoiled Filo just a little too much.”
“No, wait — how does spoiling her turn into training her to be some kind of bratty little brat?”
This strange script being drilled into Filo-tan apparently went by the name of “bratty girl training.” Father sure knew a lot of things!

“Well, you see, at first she was fairly sharp and lively, but whether it’s the environment or simply too much peace, Filo’s been slowly turning into Sakura. She kept spacing out, so I’ve been training her to keep her Filo-ness intact.”
“Choco~ zako zako~”
Filo-tan was demanding more chocolate from Rafumi. With a *ping!*, Rafumi flicked another piece her way.
“Sakura-fication… you mean like some other possible version of Filo-chan?”
“Indeed. A more easygoing, dreamy Filolial. One prone to spacing out constantly.”
“The one here is Filo-tan, not Sakura-chan, I say!”
What in the world was Rafumi talking about!
“That’s exactly my point — this peaceful environment is turning Filo into something resembling Sakura. Look at that spineless expression!”
“Hmm?”
Filo-tan was blissfully munching on chocolate, wearing a completely spaced-out look — of course, still in her Filolial-sama form.
“I’ve done all sorts of things to keep her as Filo, but it’s ultimately a stopgap measure. With an owner like this, it’s only natural she’d gradually turn into Sakura.”
“Isn’t that just an indirect way of insulting me?”
“I never said that, did I? If she’s sheltered from the world’s harshness and protected by all sorts of people, this is the result.”
Rafumi was spouting nonsense, I say.
“Well, perhaps some precariousness is important now and then… but a light adjustment should be enough for now, so this is the sort of training I’m giving her.”
“Isn’t that just going to turn her into some other kind of Filo-chan?”
“Without a somewhat extreme teaching method, adjustment is difficult. Normally she’d settle around the level of, say, a female Kou… but this dreaminess is, in the end, just Sakura peeking through.”
“Buu… I feel like something mean was just said about me~”

Ohh. Filo-tan was protesting being mocked by Rafumi, but truth be told, the feebleness of that protest was uncannily reminiscent of Sakura-chan. It was the sort of incident that might make one think Filo-tan and Sakura-chan were one and the same — but they are not, I say!

“I’ve considered lifting the ban on her pouncing on the Spear Hero, but that’s a drastic measure, a last resort. The worst outcome would be her getting worn down mentally. In that case, better a Filo who merely looks like Filo but is Sakura underneath.”
“Set Filo-tan free, I say!”
“She already is free — from you, that is.”
Guh! I say! I’ll make her pay for this someday, mark my words!

“Well, perhaps the trouble is that she’s satisfied but simply doesn’t have many people who catch her interest. Before long she’ll likely meet someone who does, so think of it as patience until then, you heroes.”
That Rafumi! Could it be she’s waiting for Fiancée to show up! What’s the meaning of favoring Fiancée while refusing to let me so much as touch Filo-tan, I say!
“To begin with, apparently back in the first world, Filo was rather sharp-tongued around this time. Her Class Up dream was reportedly to become able to spit poison.”

So Filo-tan once had such a dream. Speaking of poison, Midori and Chick were the most memorable among the Filolial-samas on that front. Of course, she was also skilled at detoxifying, and her senses in that regard were quite sharp too. I recall that when Father cooked, besides using her natural healing aptitude to speed up the aging of meat, he’d also make use of Midori and the others’ abilities to enhance flavor through poison.
“Hmm…? Zzz…”
The moment I looked away, Filo-tan had drifted off to sleep. I could hear her cute little breathing. Seeing Filo-tan’s blissfully sleeping face, Father gave a wry smile and cautioned Rafumi.
“I’ll let it slide as Rafumi-chan’s own version of adjustment, for now — but don’t go teaching Filo-chan any weird habits, okay?”

“I’ll keep it within a harmless range. I thought watching the three slaves under the Shield Hero’s command might instill some sense of urgency in her, but I suppose since she originated from Sakura, that was asking too much.”
That reminded me, all at once, of Wolf and Crocodile Guy and the others I’d glimpsed earlier.
“Six hundred seventy-seven… six hundred seventy-eight…”
Crocodile Guy was silently lifting a considerable amount of weight on an assembled chest press machine. Clank! Clank! The sound rang on and on.
“Seven hundred seventy… seven hundred seventy-one…”

Behind him, Wolf was likewise doing something resembling weightlifting, gripping a barbell loaded with equally massive plates in both hands. Naturally, the equipment’s weight had been further increased to account for a hero’s enhanced strength. These days it had grown so heavy that it had to be loaded onto a dedicated cart and hauled by several Filolial-samas. According to Father, it might soon be time to build a proper gym somewhere around Panda’s village — such was the training space Crocodile Guy and the others used.
“Hah… hah… hah…”

Rabbit Guy was running laps through that same training space in rabbit form. The whole area reeked of sweat, and mixed in among them was Éclair as well. Watching this brought to mind that foolish period when I’d bounded off to a room on Cal Mira Island, thrilled about a “date” with Big Sister, only to find her deep in training. Filo-tan, meanwhile, was off napping. Everyone else was, in their own way, thoroughly focused on physical conditioning like this. Naturally, I’d been told the equipment in this space was free for anyone to use. Keel had tried lifting something out of curiosity, groaned about the weight, and when she tried to bulk up, Luna-chan flatly refused and hauled her away. Ren and Itsuki, you ask? Hah! Not among them, I say. I suppose that meant they weren’t the type to break a sweat. Though, if it were the Ren from the first world, he’d probably have joined right in. By the way, Father would bring snacks whenever training was underway, and Crocodile Guy and the others happily accepted the offerings. …Thinking on it again, I wondered whether those under Father’s command who shared Big Sister’s same possibility were simply raised to end up training like this. Lately it seemed like the muscles on Wolf, Rabbit Guy, and Crocodile Guy had all been bulking up quite noticeably. Even accounting for being doted on by Father, wasn’t that overdoing it on the muscle front? They seemed dead set on getting thoroughly ripped. Had Big Sister been just as ripped all along, hiding it behind some illusion magic? The moment the thought crossed my mind, it felt entirely plausible. After all, Big Sister had once been utterly absorbed in push-ups. That form of hers, doing one-fingered push-ups… Around the time I first arrived at the village, when Big Sister came back, she’d been doing one-fingered handstands. What’s more, she’d even balanced on a single finger atop a needle. I figured that must be the kind of training demanding tremendous concentration. But more than training like that, I preferred running around and playing happily with Filolial-sama — dodging and catching kicks woven into practical combat drills. Ahahaha… ufufufu… running along the beach like that was truly wonderful. Oh? In my memories, I feel like Father from the first world is watching me with gentle eyes.
“That’s true… you look like you’re having a lot more fun than those overly sweaty, muscle-bound training sessions.”
Ehehe… I say.
